summaries.name: Tricky Treat Ball
summaries.summary: The Tricky Treat Ball is a treat-dispensing interactive dog toy that requires rolling it around to release treats, with adjustable difficulty level and varied treat sizes.

summaries.name: Nina Ottosson Dog Brick
summaries.summary: The Nina Ottosson Dog Brick is a puzzle toy that challenges a dog to get treats out by sliding, lifting, or rotating pieces.

summaries.name: Outward Hound Brick Puzzle
summaries.summary: The Outward Hound Brick Puzzle is a puzzle toy that challenges a dog to get treats out by sliding, lifting, or rotating pieces.

summaries.name: Outward Hound Sensory Maze
summaries.summary: The Outward Hound Sensory Maze is an interactive feeder that provides a fun and challenging way for a dog to eat meals.

summaries.name: Pet Zone Treat Wobbler
summaries.summary: The Pet Zone Treat Wobbler is an interactive feeder that provides a fun and challenging way for a dog to eat meals.

summaries.name: Hide-a-Squirrel
summaries.summary: Hide-a-Squirrel is a plush dog toy with hidden compartments and squeakers, encouraging problem-solving to find hidden treats.

summaries.name: West Paw Design's Wobbler
summaries.summary: West Paw Design's Wobbler is a weighted, treat-dispensing dog toy that wobbles and moves as a fun, challenging way to get treats out.

summaries.name: Snuffle Mat
summaries.summary: The Snuffle Mat is a sensory mat that provides a fun and calming way for a dog to engage its sense of smell and explore.

summaries.name: Pawfect Pets Sensory Mat
summaries.summary: The Pawfect Pets Sensory Mat is a sensory mat that provides a fun and calming way for a dog to engage its sense of smell and explore.

summaries.name: Tug-A-Jug
summaries.summary: The Tug-A-Jug is a tug toy with hidden treats that encourages a dog to use problem-solving skills to get the treats out.

summaries.name: Ever Pet Interactive Tug Toy
summaries.summary: The Ever Pet Interactive Tug Toy is a tug toy with hidden treats that encourages a dog to use problem-solving skills to get the treats out.

summaries.name: Petcube Bites
summaries.summary: Petcube Bites is an electronic interactive dog toy/camera that allows remote interaction, dispensing treats and playing with a dog even when the owner is away.

summaries.name: Furbo Interactive Dog Camera
summaries.summary: The Furbo Interactive Dog Camera is an electronic interactive toy/camera that allows remote interaction, dispensing treats and playing with a dog even when the owner is away.
